CityBoy Movement Ogun Hits 150,000 Members, Sets Sights on 500,000 by 2027

The CityBoy Movement in Ogun State signed up more than 150,000 active members within a month of starting its membership drive. With new state executives and a secretariat in Abeokuta, the movement now aims for 500,000 members before January 2027.
